fields.description: Magic constant word 0 of the 8-byte settings block at EEPROM address 0x3F0 (file offset 0x3F0*8 = 0x1F80). Written from ROM halfword at 0x0801c140, validated on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c114 writes (short)_DAT_0801c140 into buffer word 0 and stores the block via FUN_08063170(0x3F0); FUN_0801c184 reloads it via FUN_080630b8(0x3F0) and requires buffer[0] == ROM constant before accepting the save. Baseline logical bytes at 0x1F80 are 0x23 0x01 = 0x0123.
fields.name: header_id_a

fields.description: Magic constant word 1 of the settings block. Written from ROM halfword at 0x0801c144, validated on load against the live expected value.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c114 writes (short)_DAT_0801c144 into buffer word 1; FUN_0801c184 requires buffer[1] == uRam0801c210 before accepting the save. Baseline logical bytes at 0x1F82 are 0x67 0x45 = 0x4567.
fields.name: header_id_b

fields.description: Live gameplay/config option byte: its low byte is sourced from a RAM setting at save time and restored into a RAM setting variable at boot. Exact in-game meaning (sound/options style flag) is not named in the decomp slice.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c114 stores (ushort)(byte)*_DAT_0801c148 into buffer word 2; FUN_0801c184 restores (char)buffer[2] into *puRam0801c220 after checksum validation. Baseline value is 0x00.
fields.name: option_value

fields.description: High byte of the settings word; always written as zero because only a byte value is stored.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c114 assigns psVar4[2] = (ushort)bVar1 (single byte, high byte zero); FUN_0801c184 only reads the low (char) byte. Baseline value is 0x00.
fields.name: option_word_high

fields.description: Additive checksum word: stored value equals header_id_a + header_id_b + settings word (mod 0x10000). Baseline: 0x0123 + 0x4567 + 0x0000 = 0x468A.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801c114 computes psVar4[3] = word2 + word0 + word1 before FUN_08063170(0x3F0); FUN_0801c184 rejects the block unless buffer[3] == buffer[1] + buffer[0] + buffer[2], rewriting defaults via FUN_0801c114 on mismatch. Verified against samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: checksum_store
